snippet.description:

Read more here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3558400/view/534348484694770230

About Backseat Drivers:
Backseat Drivers is a game of 2-player co-op car-nage where two witless fools make a car journey together ... but the driver is elderly and can’t see over the steering wheel, and the passenger is a little boy yelling directions from the backseat. And the car is BARELY holding itself together. Can you and your relationship survive the mayhem to reach your destination? Buckle up—things are about to get wild!
